raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-STP-YouthEmployment",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Training institutions lack adequate equipment, infrastructure and staff, risking delayed or low‑quality delivery of market‑aligned courses.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Phase upgrades, procure modern equipment, fund staff recruitment and training, and monitor capacity against a standardized checklist.",
      "evidence": "Section 12: capacity constrained by outdated equipment, limited infrastructure, insufficient operating budgets, staffing gaps."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Geographic isolation of Príncipe may hinder construction logistics and beneficiary access to the new training centre.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop detailed transport plans, use local contractors, and provide remote‑learning modules and transport subsidies for participants.",
      "evidence": "Section 30: Príncipe’s geographic isolation and limited skilled‑worker pool constrain diversification and growth."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Increased frequency of floods, storms and landslides could disrupt construction and training activities.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply climate‑resilient design (EDGE, rainwater harvesting), install backup generators, and schedule works outside peak hazard periods.",
      "evidence": "Section 4 & 61: STP vulnerable to coastal floods, storms, landslides; climate events may disrupt service delivery."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Delays in recording financial transactions and internal audits may weaken fiduciary controls.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint an experienced accountant, customize the accounting system for timely reporting, and enforce quarterly audit reviews.",
      "evidence": "Section 56: FM risks include delays in recording transactions and internal audit reviews."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Procurement may be slowed if AFAP and ministries fail to coordinate technical specifications and evaluation committees.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish joint procurement task‑forces, finalize TORs early, and set clear timelines for evaluation panels.",
      "evidence": "Section 57: procurement performance depends on close collaboration between AFAP and MLSSS."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Only 6 % of youth are enrolled in TVET, limiting the pool of participants for the project.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Intensive outreach, scholarships covering transport/accommodation, and partnerships with schools to raise awareness and enrollment.",
      "evidence": "Section 12: Only six percent of STP’s youth are currently enrolled in TVET."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Female participants may face gender‑based violence or sexual exploitation during training or internships.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire GBV/SEA specialist, enforce strict codes of conduct, provide safe facilities and grievance mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "Legal covenants: AFAP must hire a Social Specialist with GBV/SEA expertise."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Insufficient private‑sector commitment could limit apprenticeship slots and on‑the‑job training opportunities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Create Workforce Development Committees, offer performance‑based compensation to firms, and set minimum placement targets.",
      "evidence": "Section 27: Employers engaged via Workforce Development Committees and partial compensation based on student numbers."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Failure to meet IDA disbursement conditions could postpone fund releases.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Track all pre‑conditions, submit required reports on schedule, and maintain a compliance checklist.",
      "evidence": "Conditions section: Disbursement requires execution of Sub‑Grant forms and payment agent hiring."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "The new labor‑market information system may remain under‑utilized, reducing its impact on employment services.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide intensive staff training, integrate system with existing databases, and set usage KPIs linked to funding.",
      "evidence": "Section 32: Employment Observatory never fully operationalized; new system to be cloud‑based."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "The Contingent Emergency Response Component manual might be delayed, limiting rapid response to crises.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Draft the CERC manual during project set‑up, obtain early approval, and train staff on activation procedures.",
      "evidence": "Section 47: CERC manual to be prepared and adopted after project effectiveness."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Risk of elite capture or exclusion of the most vulnerable if targeting criteria are not transparent.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Use USR data for objective selection, publish criteria, and monitor grievance redress outcomes.",
      "evidence": "Section 59: Risks of exclusion and elite capture if benefits not equitably distributed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Climate‑smart curricula may not be adopted by firms, limiting relevance of training.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Involve employers in curriculum design via Workforce Development Committees and conduct post‑training adoption surveys.",
      "evidence": "Section 27: Committees will identify skills gaps, including climate‑smart agriculture."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Low uptake of labor‑mobility information could reduce migration‑linked job opportunities.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Promote the Employability Portal, partner with overseas employers, and run information campaigns on safe migration.",
      "evidence": "Section 24: Labor mobility approach includes portal and partnerships with destination employers."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Insufficient monitoring and evaluation capacity may lead to poor data quality and limited learning.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Hire Data/IT assistant, conduct regular data audits, and provide M&E training to PIU staff.",
      "evidence": "Legal covenants: AFAP must hire a Data/IT assistant within 60 days of effectiveness."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Political or administrative changes in ministries could affect project governance and continuity.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Formalize the coordination committee with clear terms of reference and maintain regular ministerial briefings.",
      "evidence": "Section 49: Coordination committee established under authority of the Minister of Labor."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Severe weather events could damage the new training centre on Príncipe, causing cost overruns.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply EDGE certification, incorporate flood‑resilient design, and secure appropriate construction insurance.",
      "evidence": "Section 31: Construction will meet EDGE standards and include climate‑resilient design."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Limited private‑sector capacity may not absorb all trained youth, leading to unemployment after training.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Scale self‑employment grants, entrepreneurship boosters, and linkages to export markets to create alternative jobs.",
      "evidence": "Section 3: Economy dominated by few medium/large firms; MSMEs are 92 % but low‑productivity."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Corruption or fraud in procurement and grant disbursement could erode project credibility and funds.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce World Bank procurement rules, conduct independent audits, and publish procurement outcomes publicly.",
      "evidence": "Section 57: Procurement to follow World Bank regulations and anti‑fraud guidelines."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Insufficient digital connectivity may limit use of the Employability Portal and data systems.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Invest in connectivity upgrades, provide backup power, and test portal performance before rollout.",
      "evidence": "Section 28: Physical investments include connectivity upgrades to enable access to digital technologies."
    }
  ]
}
